campaign_inputs.run2024i_policy: Use the standard MINIv6NANOv15 production and frozen retained records from the completed 2024 campaign; do not reintroduce audited permanent skips.

target_selection: looseId; miniPFRelIso_all is not part of the probe pass/fail definition
denominator: reconstructed tracker muon with 5 < pT < 10 GeV and abs(eta) < 2.4, without a LooseID or mini-isolation requirement
tag: tight high-purity muon with miniPFRelIso_all < 0.1 matched to the reference trigger object
trigger_object_bit_source: CMSSW_15_0_X PhysicsTools/NanoAOD trigger-object muon quality bit 4, two-muon filter
reference_trigger_strategy: The trigger-matched tight tag selects the event. The tracker-muon probe is not required to pass LooseID, mini-isolation, or trigger-object matching.
adoption_gates: probe denominator audit proves LooseID and mini-isolation are absent
Muon_isTracker branch presence in data and simulation
simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted bin
bin-by-bin scale-factor stability under fit-model, fit-window, binning, and pileup variations
